title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：paint　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 paint 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the writer ① mixed the paint that no reader in the study would have recorded, and he said the mixing was the whole of the month. The ② paint, meaning the colour itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; paint, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of paint in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ paint at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Paint, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the writer said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the paint was the whole of the matter, meaning the beauty and not the colour. The ⑥ paint, meaning the beauty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; paint, he said, is either something you mix or the only word that means both colour and a beauty. He said the beauty is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ paint had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ paint of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of recording; paint, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ paint I remember is the paint recorded in the manuscript, which closed in 1993 and is still recorded as the quietest in the study. ⑩ Paint, my mother said in 1995, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all paint, she said, is a beauty that has agreed to look like colour. She said the beauty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 油漆；颜料（指书斋里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 油漆；颜料（指那桶油漆本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：mix the paint 调这一桶油漆
D. n. 油漆；颜料（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 油漆之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的油漆之事）
F. n. 油漆；颜料（指手稿里写到、被记载的那一桶）
G. n. 油漆、色泽（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 色泽（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mixed the paint that no reader in the study would have recorded
The paint, meaning the colour itself and not the page
Every sort of paint in that study
the paint at the far shelf
the paint was the whole of the matter
the paint had become a line in a manuscript
The paint of the whole thing

answers.why: mix the paint 意为“调这一桶油漆”，1986 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯记载的一桶油漆做了一遍。
paint 意为“油漆；颜料”，指那桶油漆本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
paint 意为“油漆；颜料”，指书斋里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
paint 意为“油漆；颜料”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
paint 意为“油漆、色泽”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这桶色泽就是那件事的全部。
paint 意为“色泽”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那桶油漆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
paint 意为“油漆；颜料”，指手稿里写到、被记载的那一桶，到 1991 年这一桶成了手稿里的一行。
paint 意为“油漆之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的油漆之事是一处书斋和三个月份的记载。
paint 意为“油漆；颜料”，我记得的是手稿里记载过的那一桶，1993 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一桶。
paint 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，油漆是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的油漆。
